ex.en: Most students now use a mobile phone instead of a watch to check the time.
ex.zh: 现在多数学生用手机而不是手表看时间。

words.note: mobile phone 是英式说法；美式多直接说 cell phone。

ex.en: The exam consists of multiple-choice questions and one short essay.
ex.zh: 这场考试由选择题和一篇短文组成。

words.note: multi-（多）+ -ple → 多重的；与 multiply 同源。

ex.en: The exhibition shows the evolution of printing over five centuries.
ex.zh: 展览呈现了印刷术五个世纪以来的演变。

words.note: e-（向外）+ volv（卷）→ 逐渐展开、演变；动词 evolve。

ex.en: Hotel prices rise sharply during the peak season in summer.
ex.zh: 夏季旺季时酒店价格大幅上涨。

words.note: peak 指山顶或最高点；at one's peak 表处于最佳状态。

ex.en: The old town is a magnet for tourists from all over the world.
ex.zh: 这座老城吸引着世界各地的游客。

words.note: magnet 由磁铁引申为有吸引力的人或地方；magnetic 有磁性的。

ex.en: It is hard to concentrate on reading when the television is on.
ex.zh: 电视开着时很难专心阅读。

words.note: concentrate on 后接名词或动名词；名词 concentration。

ex.en: The report exposed serious weaknesses in the safety system.
ex.zh: 这份报告揭露了安全系统中的严重缺陷。

words.note: expose sb to sth 表使接触、使暴露；名词 exposure。

ex.en: This versatile little tool can cut, open bottles and tighten screws.
ex.zh: 这件多用途小工具可以切割、开瓶和拧螺丝。

words.note: vers-（转）+ -atile → 可多向发展的，即多用途、多才。

ex.en: The article compares quality versus quantity in language learning.
ex.zh: 这篇文章比较了语言学习中的质量与数量。

words.note: versus 常缩写成 vs.，用于比较或比赛双方。

ex.en: The hotel received several complaints about the noise from the street.
ex.zh: 酒店收到了几起关于街道噪音的投诉。

words.note: complain 是动词，complaint 是名词，常与 make 连用。

ex.en: Smoking is not permissible anywhere inside the building.
ex.zh: 大楼内任何地方都不允许吸烟。

words.note: per-（通过）+ miss（放行）→ 可允许的；反义 impermissible。

ex.en: Early tests can greatly increase the chances of surviving cancer.
ex.zh: 早期检查能大大提高癌症存活的机会。

words.note: cancer 表疾病时不可数，指种类时可数；形容词 cancerous。

ex.en: The children splashed water at each other in the pool.
ex.zh: 孩子们在泳池里互相泼水。

words.note: make a splash 引申为引起轰动；splash out 指花钱。

ex.en: The nurse injected the vaccine into his arm without any pain.
ex.zh: 护士把疫苗注射到他的手臂里，一点也不疼。

words.note: inject A into B 或 inject B with A，都是正确搭配。

ex.en: Their romance began on a train journey through southern Italy.
ex.zh: 他们的恋情始于一次穿越意大利南部的火车旅行。

words.note: romance 兼指恋情、浪漫气氛与传奇故事；形容词 romantic。

ex.en: He took offense at the joke, though it was meant kindly.
ex.zh: 他对这个玩笑感到不快，尽管对方本是好意。

words.note: take offense at 表因…见怪；英式拼 offence。

ex.en: She found the small island in an old atlas of the Pacific.
ex.zh: 她在一本旧的太平洋地图集里找到了那个小岛。

words.note: atlas 源自希腊神话中托举天空的阿特拉斯。

ex.en: These bacteria are invisible to the naked eye.
ex.zh: 这些细菌肉眼看不见。

words.note: in-（不）+ vis（看）+ -ible → 看不见的。

ex.en: The camera focused on the child playing in the garden.
ex.zh: 相机对焦在花园里玩耍的孩子身上。

words.note: focus 复数可为 focuses 或 foci；focus on 表专注于。

ex.en: Heavy snow hampered rescue efforts in the mountain area.
ex.zh: 大雪阻碍了山区的救援工作。

words.note: hamper 指妨碍进展或行动，常用于救援、调查等语境。

ex.en: We stopped at a roadside motel because the highway was closed.
ex.zh: 因为高速公路封闭，我们在一家路边汽车旅馆过夜。

words.note: motel 由 motor 与 hotel 缩合而成，多建于公路旁。

ex.en: We need a new approach to the problem of traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 我们需要用新方法解决交通拥堵问题。

words.note: an approach to doing sth 中 to 是介词，后接动名词。

ex.en: It is no exaggeration to say that the film changed her life.
ex.zh: 说这部电影改变了她的人生，毫不夸张。

words.note: it is no exaggeration to say 意为毫不夸张地说。

ex.en: The government pegged the price of fuel for six months.
ex.zh: 政府把燃油价格固定了六个月。

words.note: peg 作动词可表固定、限定价格或汇率。

ex.en: It is a common myth that we use only ten percent of our brains.
ex.zh: 我们只用了大脑的百分之十，这是一个常见的错误看法。

words.note: myth 指神话，也常指广为流传的错误看法。

ex.en: Her decisive answer ended the argument at once.
ex.zh: 她果断的回答立刻结束了争论。

words.note: decisive 表决定性的或果断的；名词 decision。

ex.en: Please write a concise summary of the report in no more than two pages.
ex.zh: 请写一份不超过两页的报告摘要。

words.note: concise 强调用词少而清楚；与 brief 近义但更正面。

ex.en: The decision has serious implications for the future of the industry.
ex.zh: 这一决定对行业的未来有重大影响。

words.note: implication 常用复数表影响、后果，也指暗示。

ex.en: She spent two years collecting data for her doctoral thesis.
ex.zh: 她花了两年时间为博士论文收集数据。

words.note: thesis 复数为 theses；也指文章或演讲的中心论点。

ex.en: I bumped into an old classmate at the railway station yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我在火车站偶然遇到了一位老同学。

words.note: bump into 既表撞上也表偶然遇见，口语常用。
